notes: IO-Link (IEC 61131-9, SDCI) does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The VendorID, DeviceID, RevisionID, COM rate, and identification strings are Device configuration (often factory-programmed) exposed via the Direct Parameter page and the ISDU. An implementation may back these with non-volatile storage, but the standard only requires the identity be readable and the communication parameters be consistent. Optional Data Storage backs up Device parameters at the Master so a replaced Device is auto-parameterized.
